# Valor Legacies — Customer Information Reference
# https://valorlegacies.com/llms-full.txt

Valor Legacies is a veteran-founded, family-focused life insurance resource. The customer website organizes educational guidance around real life chapters rather than products or technical systems.

## Life Insurance Guide Categories

- New Parents
- Homeowners
- Work Benefits
- Final Expense
- Retirement & Legacy
- Veterans & Military Families
- Coverage Basics

The guides help families identify what may be missing, challenge common assumptions, consider what could be left unprotected, prepare practical questions, and understand how life insurance may help depending on eligibility and policy terms.

## Consumer Journey

Visitors may read the Life Insurance Guides or start the Protection Path. A visitor does not need to know which policy fits. After a consumer submits their information and consent, the request is reviewed before a licensed insurance professional may follow up.

## Boundaries and Disclosures

Valor Legacies is not an insurance company and does not promise approval, rates, savings, investment performance, or guaranteed outcomes. Coverage depends on state availability, underwriting, carrier guidelines, and policy terms. Valor Legacies is not affiliated with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, or any government agency.

For agent, admin, developer, API, or integration information, use https://valorlegacies.xyz/developers or https://valorlegacies.xyz/llms.txt. Technical endpoint instructions are intentionally not published on valorlegacies.com.
